description: This file defines Swagger API resource classes for client identifier management in the Fineract project. It contains nested classes representing request and response schemas for various API endpoints such as getting, posting, putting, and deleting client identifiers.

classes.name: ClientIdentifiersApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Container class for Swagger schema definitions related to client identifiers API in Fineract.

classes.name: GetClientsClientIdIdentifiersResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when retrieving client identifiers, including nested document type information.

classes.name: GetClientsDocumentType
classes.description: Schema representing a type of document (e.g., driver's license) associated with client identification.

classes.name: PostClientsClientIdIdentifiersRequest
classes.description: Schema for the request payload when creating a new client identifier.

classes.name: PutClientsClientIdIdentifiersIdentifierIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a client identifier, including a reference to the changed details.

classes.name: PostClientsClientIdIdentifiersResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a new client identifier, including resource identifiers.

classes.name: DeleteClientsClientIdIdentifiersIdentifierIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after deleting a client identifier.
